silhouette: Compact rounded bulbous body with a high arching top handle and a sharp diagonal projecting spout

parts.name: body
parts.shape: Spherical flattened sphere with a flat circular base and narrower top opening rim
parts.connection: Central foundation element to which all other components attach

parts.name: spout
parts.shape: Tapered conical tube curving upward and outward with an angled open mouth at the tip
parts.connection: Weld-joined to the lower side of the rounded body

parts.name: handle
parts.shape: Semi-circular arched strap with flattened ends
parts.connection: Attached at two opposite points on the upper shoulder of the body

parts.name: lid
parts.shape: Stepped circular disc with a matching inner flange
parts.connection: Placed loosely into the top opening rim of the body

parts.name: knob
parts.shape: Small spherical sphere or truncated cone
parts.connection: Fixed to the exact center of the top surface of the lid

recognitionCues: Upward curving spout positioned on the side
Arched handle spanning over the top center
Fitted lid with a central lifting knob
